segments.title: Cold Open: Tech Failures and Eye Sty
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns from travel wrestling with wireless headphone failures, cord tangles, and a persistent under-eye sty he jokes is herpes, while Pepito demands beans.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Anchors: Pentagon Execution and Animal News
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple fills the anchor desk covering the Pentagon's plan to live-stream a Fort Hood shooter's firing squad execution on December 3rd, then runs through a bear attacking a car in Japan, a two-headed terrapin in Massachusetts, a loose cow on a Florida highway, a deer freed from netting in New Jersey, a Canadian grandmother's plank record, and the world's two oldest men exchanging birthday gifts.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: The Yanking Philosophy
segments.notes: Hype Train hijacks the broadcast for a seventeen-minute freestyle constructing an entire metaphysics of 'yanking' — distinguishing it from gooning, introducing 'yank exception' and 'yank fauna' as transcendent states, and thanking subscribers through yank-themed wordplay.

segments.title: Brandon's Streets of Rage 2 Session: Controller Chaos
segments.notes: Brandon battles Genesis emulation failures, a non-functional controller, his mother's hallway commentary (including Pastor Joe and Gooters improv night), and accidental webcam exposure while playing as Blaze, eventually keyboard-mashing through the first stage.

segments.title: Close: Trump Clip and Patreon Plug
segments.notes: Case reclaims the desk, airs a muted-then-unmuted Trump clip threatening to 'let him take out Los Angeles' as a 'small price to pay,' plugs tomorrow's Patreon stream, and raids out.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Returns from travel with a sty and tech woes, adopts a 'new chill case' persona, cedes desk to Jeff Ripple, later reclaims it for close.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Fills anchor chair with a 'Jeffrey Puddle' bit, delivers Pentagon execution story and animal news while trading barbs with Hype Train and Case.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derails the broadcast into a seventeen-minute 'yanking' philosophy freestyle, inventing 'yank exception' and 'yank fauna' while processing subs.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Briefly appears demanding beans and commenting on Case's cord nightmare.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Struggles through a Streets of Rage 2 remote plagued by emulator crashes, controller failure, maternal interruptions, and accidental face reveal.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Briefly interrupts Brandon's setup claiming he's busy with improv at a 7-Eleven Gooters night.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell has a persistent under-eye sty he jokes may be herpes, and claims to be writing a children's book about it becoming his best friend.
Case Blackwell and Fiona are collaborating on a project targeting a pre-Halloween release, and Fiona has a new Red Bull Racing show.
Brandon's mother references 'Pastor Joe' and 'Gooters improv stand up at the 7-Eleven' during her hallway interventions.
Brandon's webcam accidentally activates during his faceless CryptoZeu$ stream, revealing his face on air.
Trump clip aired at close threatens to 'let him take out Los Angeles' and 'San Diego' as a 'small price to pay' for keeping the world safe.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from travel beset by headphone failures and an eye sty, surrendering the news desk to Jeff Ripple who covers a Pentagon plan to live-stream a firing squad execution alongside a parade of animal stories. Hype Train commandeers the middle of the broadcast for an extended 'yanking' metaphysics freestyle, while Brandon's CryptoZeu$ segment collapses into emulator crashes, controller failure, and maternal chaos before Case closes with a Trump clip threatening Los Angeles and a Patreon plug.
